title: Development of an artificial intelligence algorithm for automated detection of cardiovascular intervention-related complications.
summary: The EHR model detects specified cardiovascular-intervention complications, with retrospective development and prospective single-institution validation. Performance supports this bounded ascertainment result; PPV/F1 and single-center scope limit generalization. The result is reported in the Netherlands Heart Journal. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
